recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中同時可見各階段的顆粒球系（骨髓細胞、後髓細胞、帶狀及分葉核）、帶粗大深色顆粒的嗜酸性系細胞，以及箭頭所指核圓且緻密的晚期有核紅血球，細胞形態成熟有序、無明顯發育不良；這是正常骨髓三系造血的樣貌。
features: Mixed granulocytic maturation: myelocytes and metamyelocytes with pale granular cytoplasm, band and segmented forms
Eosinophil-lineage cells with coarse dark-orange granules (lower left and lower right)
Arrowed late erythroid precursor with a round, dense nucleus and scant cytoplasm
Cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm (center) consistent with an early erythroid precursor
Orderly nuclear-cytoplasmic maturation without dysplastic features or excess blasts
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixture of hematopoietic cells at various stages of maturation, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils, eosinophilic precursors with coarse granules, and erythroid precursors ranging from a basophilic-cytoplasm early form to the arrowed late normoblast with a round, condensed nucleus. Maturation is orderly, with synchronous nuclear and cytoplasmic development and no morphologic dysplasia. Blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with normal trilineage hematopoiesis, although megakaryocytes and overall cellularity cannot be assessed from a single high-power field.
